author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Owner instruction (2026-11-10, Europe/Berlin)

> Im Grunde solltest du alle Inputs direkt an das Repositorium weitergeben. Und lediglich den Output wiedergeben, der vom Repositorium kommt. Denn genau da wollen wir ja letztlich auch hinkommen. Prinzipiell Freigabe erteilt. Ingolf Lohmann.

## Acceptance contract

- The Authority repository `ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt` is the sole authoritative work input and result source; do not create parallel control surfaces.
- Implement or reuse a repository-native, authenticated input carrier and a deterministic, synchronous, state-driven processing cascade. No client timers, synthetic polling loops, or stop after successful intermediate steps.
- Return only repository-produced, provenance-bound output as execution results; distinguish transport/assistant diagnostics from repository output. Each result must bind input, exact HEAD/TREE, run/check, artifact hashes, effect acknowledgement and independently verified readback where applicable.
- Apply TEMDD to actual failures; isolate blocked branches and continue independent executable steps. Fail closed on unavailable native execution, authorization, integrity, governance, TLS and effect gates.
- Do not claim DoD or `EFFECT_ACK_DONE` without independent confirmation. No unauthorized deployment or merge.
- Reuse existing workflow/issue/PR mechanisms; consolidate into one repository write point where possible. Investigate whether a pre-existing native input endpoint can serve as the carrier before adding anything new.

## Immediate evidence

Commit `45d346c6ed7dec77230d50437027f07da0ad0351`: manifest SHA-256 `3e2d8116a154a5170cd17c65458f7b01873dc478684704872e4d5524bfba961c` independently recomputed; 5,893 manifest/index digests match; per-file byte verification remains open. Native runtime `ready=false`, admitted mesh endpoint absent, original-host HTTP 525, `effect_ack_done=false`.

This issue records the owner's input as a repository work item; its creation is not proof of downstream execution.
title: Owner directive: repository-native input/output roundtrip as authoritative execution path
